summary.en: A JavaScript port of the NES classic Duck Hunt, with mouse light-gun play and the original game flow.
summary.zh: 红白机《打鸭子》的 JS 移植版，含光枪（鼠标）交互与原版流程。

description.en: Ducks burst from the grass — shoot them down with your mouse before they escape. Each round sets a quota, and miss too many and the dog laughs you off the stage.
description.zh: 鸭子从草丛飞出，在限定时间内用鼠标点击击落，每关有配额，漏掉太多即失败。

tip.en: Mouse and touch controls out of the box mean it plays on mobile with no keyboard at all. Art plus audio tracks keep it mid-sized — a natural fit for a retro NES section.
tip.zh: 鼠标/触屏操作，天然适配移动端，无需键盘就能玩。素材是图片+音轨，体积中等，适合放「怀旧红白机」分类。
